description: Read a FigJam/Figma URL with the configured Figma token and persist a local snapshot for get_board_context, answer_from_board and diff_board; the summary names the largest sections to read next and how many excerpts lie outside sections. Leaves the Figma file unchanged. Every call downloads the board from Figma (one Tier 1 request); get_board_context and answer_from_board read the saved snapshot without a new request. Balanced/quality modes may send board text and images to the configured LLM provider and incur charges; max_speed skips vision. Re-ingest to refresh stale content and continue pending image interpretation; focusNodeIds with section IDs from the summary or the first page of get_board_context interprets their images first. Local history is bounded. Supports framework phases or customPhases.

customPhases.description: Free-form phase names to map clusters onto (e.g. ["Ideen", "Feedback", "Offene Fragen"]); overrides docStructureHint

docStructureHint.description: Built-in framework used to map clusters to phases

figmaAccessToken.description: Figma personal access token; falls back to FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN env var if omitted

figmaFileUrl.description: URL of the FigJam/Figma file to ingest

focusNodeIds.description: IDs of pages, sections, frames, groups or single nodes whose image clusters are interpreted first, in list order; the rest of the board follows in the usual order. Section IDs come from the ingest_board summary or the first page of get_board_context. Only the order of image interpretation changes: the whole board is still read and cached, and later ingests without focusNodeIds reuse the interpretations. No effect in max_speed

forceFullIngest.description: Build the snapshot from the downloaded board again instead of the cached result for unchanged content, e.g. after turning credential redaction off. Image interpretations of unchanged clusters are kept, as without forceFullIngest; clusters still pending are interpreted as on any ingest. Model and prompt changes are detected automatically, so forceFullIngest is not needed for them. An unchanged board gives no new snapshot for diff_board. Default: false

ingestMode.description: How aggressively to use vision LLM calls during ingest

name: ingest_board

figmaRequests.description: Figma requests of this ingest for images: image fills (Tier 2) and renders (Tier 1)

focus.description: Only with focusNodeIds: the IDs found on the board and the clusters in focus this ingestMode interprets, of them interpreted and pending

relationCount.description: Directed cluster-to-cluster relations derived from connector arrows

title: Ingest FigJam Board
